name: Ma Tenshi Seraphim -Seito Kanraku-
original_name: 魔天使セラフィム-聖都陥落-
source:
In a fantasy world ruled by a demon king, the protagonist must take down the holy land of Avalon via two enslaved heroines, Seraphim and Yurie.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075878.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
在这个由魔王统治的幻想世界中，主人公必须借助被奴役的女主角塞拉菲姆与由利绘之手，攻陷圣地阿瓦隆。

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075878.html]DLsite[/url]]
